text:
anya-support: FYI customer finn_corp reports intermittent 403s on SSO after their IdP cert rotation. They say it worked for a while then started failing for some users.

finn_corp: seeing ~20% login failures with SAML response errors: 'RecipientMismatch' or HTTP 403 at our ACS. Happens after rolling new signing certs at IdP. No config changes on our side.

anya-support: can you paste the SAML error/stack from our gateway logs? Also which ACS URL are they sending in AuthnRequest?

finn_corp: here's the gateway spike and the SAML error we captured:
```
2026-02-17T18:02:12Z redwood-gw[auth]: ERROR saml: recipient mismatch: expected=https://app.finncorp.com/saml/acs got=https://proxy.edge.company.com/saml/acs
SAMLResponse: <samlp:Response ...>...Assertion Recipient="https://proxy.edge.company.com/saml/acs"... </samlp:Response>
```

anya-support: ok so the Assertion Recipient is the proxy host which differs from the ACS our IdP metadata includes. Is finn_corp terminating TLS at a CDN/edge that rewrites host header?

finn_corp: yes we have a CDN that rewrites origin host to proxy.edge.company.com. We thought Redwood would honor X-Forwarded-Host.

ben-eng: @anya-support tagging because this looks like the backend gateway isn't normalizing the recipient/acs check for X-Forwarded-Host in our proxy chain. We recently tightened recipient validation during cert rotation to avoid assertion replay.

carmen-sre: quick triage steps: 1) confirm metadata entityID + ACS in IdP, 2) check whether IdP's new cert chain is being served (intermediate missing), 3) verify headers from CDN to our gateway.

anya-support: finn_corp can you run these and paste outputs:
1) curl -I https://idp.finncorp.com/metadata | head -n 20
2) openssl s_client -showcerts -connect idp.finncorp.com:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint

finn_corp: outputs below. Metadata returns OK but cert fingerprint is the new one. Metadata contains ACS https://app.finncorp.com/saml/acs (no proxy host). CDN is adding X-Forwarded-Host=proxy.edge.company.com and X-Forwarded-Proto=https

ben-eng: this matches root cause: IdP signed assertions use Recipient=the host the browser hit (proxy.edge...), not the origin ACS. We need to accept forwarded host as canonical when comparing recipient, or instruct customers to preserve original host in SAML flow.

carmen-sre: mitigation options:
- Short term: instruct finn_corp to configure their IdP to sign with Recipient matching proxy host (bad).
- Better: we update gateway to consider X-Forwarded-Host when validating Recipient if the header is from a trusted CDN source.
- Alternate: put a rewrite on CDN to preserve Host header to app.finncorp.com for SAML endpoints.

anya-support: customer prefers minimal config on their side. Any chance of a fast patch?

ben-eng: I'll open a hotfix: change recipient validation to normalize using either Host or X-Forwarded-Host if request comes from an IP allowlist (CDN). Patch will include a feature flag.

deploy-bot: deploy request opened: RB-3421 hotfix/saml-forwarded-host (staging -> canary).

ben-eng: patch note: in pkg/saml/validate.go we add:
```
// consider X-Forwarded-Host for recipient check when header originates from a trusted proxy
host := req.Host
if xf := req.Header.Get("X-Forwarded-Host"); xf != "" && isTrustedProxy(req.RemoteAddr) { host = xf }
// then compare host-based ACS
```

carmen-sre: also confirm idp cert rotation: did IdP publish metadata with new cert before signing traffic? If they rotated mid-roll they can sign with new cert while some SPs cache old metadata.

finn_corp: they confirmed metadata was updated first. But some intermediate CA wasn't included in the chain and a few IdP nodes fell back to older cert while signing. We saw mixed cert fingerprints.

anya-support: so two contributing factors: mixed IdP certs during rotation + recipient host mismatch because of CDN header rewrite. Both explain intermittent failures.

ben-eng: canary patch rolled out to 2% traffic. Need logs from customer after we enable flag for their org.

finn_corp: patch enabled for org=finn_corp. Initial tail shows failures drop to <1%. Will monitor. Thanks.

anya-support: final recommended actions for finn_corp:
- Ensure IdP rotates certs with full chain and serves updated metadata consistently across nodes.
- Prefer configuring CDN to preserve original Host for SAML endpoints or add trusted proxy mapping in Redwood support portal.
- We'll keep the feature flag for 48h then rollout after SRE review.

finn_corp: confirmed fix, will follow up on CDN config and IdP cert chain. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray: 

ben-eng: filing follow-up RFC to add explicit trusted-proxy header allowlist in console and a SAML troubleshooting doc that covers Host vs Recipient issues, cert chain rotation checklist, and common CDN pitfalls.

anya-support: closing thread once we validate 48h green. Thanks all.
